mapper.sql: SELECT v.id, v.vin, v.lifecycle_stage, p.model_id, m.model_name, m.series, m.spec, m.model_code, p.year_make, p.exterior_color_id, ec.color_name AS exterior_color_name, p.interior_color_id, ic.color_name AS interior_color_name, a.dealer_id, d.dealer_name FROM t_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_veh_production p ON p.vehicle_id = v.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_model m ON m.id = p.model_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_exterior_color ec ON ec.id = p.exterior_color_id AND ec.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_interior_color ic ON ic.id = p.interior_color_id AND ic.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_veh_allocation a ON a.vehicle_id = v.id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_md_dealer d ON d.id = a.dealer_id AND d.deleted = 0
